42:16.text: And those who argue concerning Allāh after He has been responded to
- their argument is invalid with their Lord, and upon them is
wrath, and for them is a severe punishment.

42:17.text: It is Allāh who has sent down the Book in truth and
. And what will make you perceive? Perhaps the Hour is near.

42:18.text: Those who do not believe in it are impatient for it,
but those who believe are fearful of it and know that it is the truth. Unquestionably, those who dispute concerning the Hour are in extreme error.

42:19.text: with His servants; He gives provision to whom He wills. And He is the Powerful, the Exalted in Might.

42:20.text: Whoever desires the harvest of the Hereafter - We increase for him in his harvest
of this world - We give him thereof, but there is not for him in the Hereafter any share.

42:21.text: who have ordained for them a religion to which Allāh has not consented? But if not for the decisive word,
it would have been concluded between them. And indeed, the wrongdoers will have a painful punishment.

42:22.text: You will see the wrongdoers fearful of what they have earned, and it will
befall them. And those who have believed and done righteous deeds will be in lush regions of the gardens
having whatever they will in the presence of their Lord. That is what is the great bounty.
